summary: Environment A direct-binary proof that Phase 22 (honest, size-based model-tier diagnostics + model-recommendation docs) is genuinely compiled into this rebuilt installer, with zero functional regression to every prior-phase Rust symbol - one benign optimizer-inlining variance is documented below.
gitCommitNote: This is the source tree commit (Phase 22's own commit) the Phase 22 rebuild was performed against. Phase 22 touches apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/commands.rs, apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/lib.rs, apps/desktop/src/config/appConfig.ts, apps/desktop/src/components/workspace/PilotDiagnosticsPanel.tsx, docs/live-speech.md, docs/first-use.md, and adds docs/phase-22-audit.md.
buildLog: ran via a background task this session (not committed - ephemeral build log)

installer.ggmlTwoPassFixNote: First build attempt failed as expected on the known whisper-rs-sys ggml lib-name defect; the build script applied its established fix and the retry succeeded - the same harmless, unrelated build-toolchain quirk documented and handled identically in every prior whisper-enabled Windows rebuild this project has done (now a 16th consecutive rebuild).

symbolRegressionCheck.method: x86_64-w64-mingw32-strings cip-desktop.exe | grep -c <symbol>, run against the extracted installer's main executable
symbolRegressionCheck.tripwiresResult: 20 of 21 counts identical to the Phase 21 baseline - zero functional regression. whisper_full_with_state stable at 96 for a 16th consecutive rebuild (Phase 7.3 through Phase 22).

deviationExplained.explanation: Phase 18's own audit already established this count as two distinct mangled symbols: cip_desktop_lib::pipeline's thin wrapper (apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/pipeline.rs, called from two sites in commands.rs) and cip_core_service::bible_intelligence's own pure function it wraps. Direct inspection of every matching string this build (`strings | grep -n`) shows only the cip_core_service::bible_intelligence mangled symbol remains (_ZN16cip_core_service18bible_intelligence48retry_paraphrase_or_semantic_with_fuller_context...) - the pipeline.rs wrapper was inlined into its two call sites by the release-mode optimizer this build, the same class of benign inlining variance already documented for should_flush_early/has_trailing_pause in Phase 21 and fuzzy_match_book's internal helpers in Phase 20. Phase 22 does not touch pipeline.rs, bible_intelligence.rs, or commands.rs's retry call sites at all - the most plausible cause is that Phase 22's own additions to commands.rs (a different, larger function in the same crate) shifted rustc's whole-crate code-size-based inlining heuristics enough to tip this specific thin wrapper over its inlining threshold this build, not any functional change. This is confirmed benign, not assumed: cargo test --workspace passed 365/365 in both feature configs (unchanged pass count from Phase 21), including every existing test that exercises this exact retry path through apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/pipeline.rs and commands.rs - a broken or removed code path would fail those tests regardless of whether the binary happens to inline it.

symbolRegressionCheck.priorPhaseNote: Every other prior-phase symbol checked, including Phase 17's own Detection Accuracy Analytics functions and Phase 20's own fuzzy_match_book/canonicalize_book, remains present and unregressed.

newSymbolsThisPhase.note: diagnose_whisper_model is directly confirmed present (it already existed pre-Phase-22; its call count is unchanged since Phase 22 only added a new field it populates, not a new call site). classify_model_size_tier was inlined by the release-mode optimizer, as expected for a small pure function called from exactly two sites within the same file (diagnose_whisper_model and, indirectly via that function, install_whisper_model) plus one call from lib.rs - consistent with this project's own established precedent (e.g. should_flush_early/has_trailing_pause in Phase 21, fuzzy_match_book's own internal levenshtein/max_allowed_distance helpers in Phase 20). Its absence from the symbol table is expected and unrelated to whether the classification itself works, which is proven instead by its 6 direct unit tests plus diagnose_whisper_model's own test asserting a size_tier_hint containing 'tiny-class' for a small test file.

frontendTextSearchLimitation: The frontend bundle is not searchable as plain strings inside cip-desktop.exe the same way Rust symbols are - the new sizeTierHint field and its PilotDiagnosticsPanel.tsx rendering were not independently string-searched, consistent with every prior phase's methodology. Frontend correctness rests on npm run typecheck's success and the full 303/303 frontend test pass (unchanged from Phase 21, since this phase's frontend change is purely additive - a new diagnostic field and its display in two existing message-construction sites).
architecturalSafetyNotes: Zero new Tauri commands, zero new events, zero new migrations, zero schema changes.

classify_model_size_tier and the extended diagnose_whisper_model are pure and have no effect on run_inference, is_multilingual, VAD-triggered flush (Phase 21), or any core/bible detection/matching logic - they only change what diagnostics say, never what the engine does.

The new create_speech_engine startup log line is log::warn!, not a blocking check - a tiny-class model still loads and runs exactly as before this phase, unchanged behavior, only a new line in the log.
Every other domain contract crate (core/bible, core/sermon, core/music, core/presentation) is entirely untouched.

Every prior-phase command and Phase 14-21 symbol remains present and unregressed, confirming this phase's addition did not disturb any prior gate or feature - with the one documented, test-verified benign inlining exception above.
